name: Wildflower 2027 application window watch
prompt:
Check whether the Wildflower! Arts & Music Festival (Richardson, TX) has opened its 2027 performer applications yet. Read the festival's own Get Involved / perform page directly rather than trusting a cached memory of it, and look for the real application link, the real deadline, and the 2027 festival dates.

Why this matters: Rad Dad played Wildflower on the Texas Credit Union Stage on May 16 2026, so they are a returning act with festival video — the strongest application they will ever file. The 2027 festival is dropping from six stages to two days and four stages, so local slots get scarcer and being early matters. Last cycle the application opened around late November and closed Jan 1, and the site currently says to check back in January.

If applications are OPEN: tell Jeff plainly, with the real application URL, the real deadline, and what the application asks for, and note that Travis Worsham is the one who actually submits and owns the relationship — never submit or contact anyone yourself. The Rad Dad research packet on my computer under /workspace/raddad-show-research/ has the fillable one-sheet to work from; refresh anything in it that has gone stale.

If applications are still closed, or the page has not changed, stay silent — no status note. Once the window has genuinely opened and Jeff has been told, delete this routine; also delete it if the 2027 deadline has clearly passed.
